status: Version 3.4. A 12th skill, recall (SUPER-ROUTER.md v2.28, Jev): best claude, second chatgpt, checked as any skill is; a recall task with no --project and no --chat comes back to the owner (nothing to recall from). Added for label test round 3, the Jev re-test the rule requires before recall goes live, with the owner's 45 labels fixed first (rule 11); if round 3 fails its bar this file goes back to 3.3. Nothing on any other skill changed from 3.3 (tests/test_skill_table_v3_4.py); the eleven old options Jev sees are version 3.1's byte for byte and recall goes as {what, not_for} (tests/test_jev_payload_v3_1.py). Round 3's score: labeltest/results/round3/.

labeler.jev_model_note: Pinned on purpose. The alias jev-latest moves when TypeSafe ships a release, which would shift scores without warning.
labeler.api_key_note: TypeSafe's Python SDK reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY by default. Pass the key in explicitly: TypeSafeClient(api_key=os.environ['JEV_API_KEY']).
labeler.question: Which one skill does this task mainly need?
labeler.fallback_description: The task fits none of the other skills: a reminder or alarm, small talk, a personal decision, or a message too unclear to label.

second_question.instructions: Does this task need two or more of the listed skills to finish?
second_question.note: Logged only, not scored. In round 1 the median answer was 0.53, so it does not separate tasks cleanly. The owner has not decided whether to keep it.

labeler.shuffle_note: TypeSafe's docs say Jev 1.13 can lean toward the first option in a list. Shuffle the option order on every call.
labeler.min_confidence_note: Provisional. Below it, the router asks the owner instead of routing. Recheck after round 2.
labeler.criteria_format_note: When a skill has a not_for field, send Jev an object for that option: {"what": description, "not_for": not_for}. Otherwise send the description string.

x_social_pulse.description: Find out what people on X (Twitter) are saying right now: sentiment, breaking news, memecoin chatter.
x_social_pulse.note: Verifier opens the source links and cross-checks on the open web. It has no X feed.

meta_social_trends.description: Find trends or posts on Instagram, Threads or Facebook.
meta_social_trends.note: Neither has a Meta feed; both have the open web, and Grok also has X as a proxy for what is trending. The owner's pair, 2026-10-13, low confidence. Muse (deferred) was the best agent in versions 3 and 3.1.

read_media.description: Describe or pull information out of an image, screenshot or video that the task provides.
read_media.note: The router copies the file to both. Video goes as still frames. ChatGPT gets images through Codex's image flag (found 13 Oct, live test pending); a PDF it cannot view, so its check of a PDF is a sanity check only.

web_research.description: Look up facts on the open web or check whether a claim is true, with source links. Not social media chatter.
web_research.note: Results must come back with source links.
web_research.not_for: Questions that can be answered from general knowledge with no lookup, such as math, unit conversions or definitions.

code.description: Write, fix or explain code, bots or scripts.
code.note: Near tie. Claude builds because the repos and files live in its workspace. Never send code to Muse's contributor tier: Meta trains on it.

writing.description: Write, edit or translate text for people to read: copy, newsletters, posts, docs.

planning.description: Break a goal into steps or split a big task into smaller tasks, without doing the steps.

computer_use.description: Carry out actions in a browser or on a computer: click, fill in forms, log in, navigate a site.

make_media.description: Create a new image or video.
make_media.note: Grok Imagine on the Grok plan, committed to the inbox repo: proven 13 Oct. Claude checks by viewing the image. Images only: Grok Bot has no video generation.

bulk_text.description: Apply the same simple step to many items: tag, sort or summarize a large batch of posts or rows.
bulk_text.note: Claude does it, Grok spot-checks a sample. Task #6 (2026-10-13) is the evidence: Claude did it, Grok passed it.

quick_answer.description: Answer a simple question from general knowledge: math, unit conversions, definitions.
quick_answer.not_for: Anything that needs today's facts, prices, dates or a source link.
quick_answer.note: The one skill with no verifier. See SUPER-ROUTER.md, Checking.

recall.description: Answer a question about earlier tasks in the same project or chat from what the router remembers: what was done, decided, produced or said, or what was planned next. The answer reports; it makes nothing new.
recall.not_for: Any task that produces something, even from an earlier result or 'from memory': writing, rewriting, shortening or redoing a text, planning, code, or anything needing new facts from the web or social media.
recall.note: Rules 2.28, Jev. Text sharpened after label test round 3 (m11, a rewrite 'from memory', went recall at 0.86). Live only after round 4 of the label test; a recall task with no --project and no --chat comes back to the owner: nothing to recall from.

changes_from_v2: Added an 11th skill, quick_answer. Claude answers alone with no verifier. The owner's decision, 6 Oct.
Added not_for lines to quick_answer and web_research so Jev can tell them apart.
writing now names translation. The owner's second look put a translation task there.
The none_of_these wording now names reminders, small talk and personal decisions.
min_confidence set to 0.8 from round 1: Jev was right 41 of 44 times at 0.8 and up, 2 of 5 below.
changes_from_v3: Added an interim field to each skill: the live agent that does the work until the best agent is switched on. null means the task comes back to the owner.
Fixed the quick_answer note to point at SUPER-ROUTER.md, Checking.
No description, not_for line or pair changed. Nothing Jev sees is different.
interim_note: All null since 2026-10-13. Since brief 24 (rules 2.34) a skill whose best agent isn't available (not live, not set up, signed out, or off after a failed safety check) goes to the next available agent in the order best, interim, second, Claude, and the card names the stand-in and why; make_media and x_social_pulse alone come back, since nothing stands in for Grok Imagine or X search. A non-null interim still goes before second place.
changes_from_v3_1: Muse deferred (SUPER-ROUTER.md v2.9). Nothing names it as best, second or interim. It stays in models and in agents.json (live false) so the door stays open.
bulk_text: best claude, second grok (was muse / grok). Evidence: task #6, 2026-10-13.
meta_social_trends: best grok, second chatgpt (was muse / grok). The owner's pair; low confidence.
read_media: not routed in v2 (agents.json skills_not_routed). best claude and second null are placeholders the validator needs; the router sends text only.
Every interim set to null: every best agent is live. If an agent is switched off, its skills come back to the owner instead of silently going to a stand-in.
No description, not_for line, skill name or option count changed. tests/test_jev_payload_v3_1.py proves the Jev payload equals version 3.1's.
changes_from_v3_2: read_media: best claude, second chatgpt, medium (was claude / null, not routed). The router copies the file to both; video goes as still frames.
make_media: best grok, second claude, medium (was chatgpt / null, not routed). Grok Imagine on the plan, committed to the inbox repo; Claude checks by viewing the image.
Both leave skills_not_routed in agents.json (rules v2.10). computer_use stays not routed.
changes_from_v3_3: Added a 12th skill, recall: answer from what the router remembers about earlier tasks under the task's tag (what was done, decided, produced or said, or what was planned next). best claude, second chatgpt, medium. SUPER-ROUTER.md v2.28, Jev; the owner's decision of 18 Oct, from the two real memory runs (#89 none_of_these 0.36, #90 writing 0.43). The entry is the owner's, byte for byte, from the round 3 task file.

recall has a not_for line, so Jev gets it as {what, not_for}: anything that needs new facts from the web or social media, or new work such as writing, planning or code, even when it starts from an earlier task.
A recall task with no --project and no --chat comes back to the owner before any call or row: nothing to recall from. Built at intake only after round 3 clears its bar.

No other skill's description, not_for line, best, second, confidence, note or interim changed, and nothing in labeler changed. The option order is shuffled per call as before; with 13 options the order for a given seed differs from 3.1's, the eleven old options themselves do not (tests/test_jev_payload_v3_1.py).

Added for label test round 3 (labeltest/data/round3: the 30 round-2 tasks again as the regression set, 8 recall questions and 7 near-misses, the owner's labels fixed before Jev ran). If round 3 fails its bar, this file is reverted to 3.3 and recall stays out.

Round 4 (2026-10-20): recall's description, not_for and note sharpened after label test round 3's miss on m11 (a rewrite 'from memory' went recall at 0.86): the answer reports and makes nothing new; any task that produces something, even from an earlier result or 'from memory' (writing, rewriting, shortening or redoing a text, planning, code, new facts), is not recall. The entry is the owner's, byte for byte, from the round 4 task file. Nothing else changed; the version stays 3.4, never merged.
